packages.description: Shared UI component library for React Native + Expo + Web.

pages.title: Bloom
pages.description: Shared UI component library for the Oxy ecosystem. React Native + Expo + Web.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.description: Install Bloom and wrap your app with the theme and dialog providers.

pages.title: Theme
pages.description: Color presets, light/dark modes, and design tokens used by every Bloom component.

pages.title: Dialog
pages.description: A single <Dialog> for every overlay surface — centered modal, side-sheet, or bottom-sheet.

pages.title: BottomSheet
pages.description: A standalone, draggable bottom sheet built on RN Modal + Reanimated + Gesture Handler.

pages.title: Toast
pages.description: Passive notifications, powered by Bloom's own universal toast engine.

pages.title: alert()
pages.description: Imperative one-shot confirmation dialogs, matching React Native's Alert.alert signature.

pages.title: Button
pages.description: The all-purpose Bloom button — variants, sizes, loading state, icons.

pages.title: TextField
pages.description: Composable text input — Root, Input, Label, Icon, Suffix.

pages.title: Avatar
pages.description: Image avatar with initials fallback, verified badge, and squircle option.

pages.title: Loading
pages.description: Spinner, top bar, skeleton, and inline loading indicators with one consistent API.

pages.title: Menu
pages.description: Compound menu — Trigger, Outer, Group, Item with icons.

pages.title: Select
pages.description: Single-choice picker — Trigger, Content, Item.

pages.title: ContextMenu
pages.description: Long-press menu (native) and right-click menu (web).

pages.title: PromptInput
pages.description: AI chat input — textarea, actions, attachments, submit, stop, fullscreen.

pages.title: SettingsList
pages.description: iOS-style grouped settings list — items, groups, dividers.

pages.title: TabBar
pages.description: A floating, minimize-on-scroll tab bar with a sliding highlight, liquid glass on iOS 26 and a backdrop-filter on web.

pages.title: Design Tokens
pages.description: The centralized semantic Tailwind / NativeWind vocabulary shared by every Oxy app.
